purpose: Check whether the largest short-run regressions persist without replacing the original corpus measurements.
selection: For each completed Mac standard-corpus checkpoint, select up to three fixtures whose selected median is more than 5% slower than baseline, ordered from largest relative regression.
order: Use the benchmark's alternating paired execution order and excluded warmups.
reporting: Retain all original corpus samples and totals. Publish diagnostic runs separately, including any persisting regressions.
